name: Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund
oneLiner: JAAA is Janus Henderson's actively managed AAA CLO fund, tokenized through Anemoy/Centrifuge as a permissioned NAV-accreting fund share rather than a $1 token.
collateral: Actively managed AAA-rated CLO tranche portfolio selected by Janus Henderson and tokenized through Anemoy / Centrifuge fund rails.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share rather than a fixed $1 token; subscriptions and redemptions are processed through permissioned Anemoy / Centrifuge primary-market rails at fund NAV.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: JAAA is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

notices.title: Contract-priced fund token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats JAAA as a NAV-priced fund share, not a liquid stablecoin peg.

mintAuthority.summary: JAAA is a permissioned Anemoy/Centrifuge fund-share token; shares are minted only when the Centrifuge pool/Hub manager approves a primary-market subscription and issues shares at NAV, with transfers restricted to whitelisted investors by a compliance hook.

controls.label: Centrifuge pool/Hub manager (share issuance)
controls.evidence: Centrifuge fund-share tokens mint only after the pool/Hub manager approves a subscription request and issues shares via the BalanceSheet/manager role; the ERC-20 share token carries a transfer/restriction hook limiting holders to whitelisted Professional Investors.

controls.label: Anemoy / Janus Henderson issuer rail
controls.evidence: Anemoy operates the permissioned primary-market rail for JAAA on Centrifuge; subscriptions/redemptions process at fund NAV through issuer-gated, KYC-restricted access.

review.evidence: Anemoy/Centrifuge docs and JAAA fund materials describe permissioned, manager-gated share issuance: minting occurs only on manager approval of primary-market subscriptions at NAV, with a freeze/restriction transfer hook on the share token. This is a role-gated fund-share mint, not a free issuer-backend stablecoin mint.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the JAAA on-chain manager/ward (Root) admin and the configured transfer-hook/restriction module across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Avalanche, and Monad.
Confirm which Safe/multisig holds the Centrifuge pool admin role for the JAAA pool.
